title: FeltCraft exact symbolic information kernel v4
summary: Exact successor to the v3 rework. If and only if separately ratified, it authorizes exactly the three sorted requested_scope atoms pure_cpu_symbolic_alignment_enumerator, symbolic_golden_report_and_scope_audit, and symbolic_kernel_unit_and_property_tests while preserving exactly the eight sorted forbidden_scope atoms. The runtime graph contains only a fail-closed authority, closed domain enumerator, isolated projection suite, twin/cost/bridge-deletion checker, and terminal golden-report validator. SK10 is an external post-implementation audit boundary and is never runtime input.
system_thesis: The paper thesis remains Dream-LoRA-Think across growing action lifetimes, with later-outcome-grounded local claims, deterministic compilation, identical text/graph/LoRA content, bounded goal-conditioned reconstruction, held-out actions, explicit graph as a primary baseline, and LoRA credited only for transport/access. V4 does not test or authorize that thesis: it is a fast exact CPU mathematical falsifier for a finite symbolic information and action geometry, not a benchmark, learned system, atoms baseline, model result, paper result, or promotion gate.

nodes.after: Pure local immutable enumerator for the literal roles, descriptors, recipes, and nested lexicographic permutation order. nodes.after: Four isolated pure principals LOCAL(cal,g), MOTIF_SCHEMA(graph,cal,g), RANDOM_SOURCE(graph0,graph1,cal,g), and ORACLE(pi,g). Each accepts only its exact closed domain, returns exactly the immutable tuple (reduced_numerator,reduced_denominator,chosen_pair,support_table), sorts complete (pair,count) support entries and tie-breaks by global descriptor-index tuple, and raises DomainError before computation for all other calls. The principals have no undeclared ingress, egress, shared object, cache, exception channel, or cross-projection reference.
nodes.rationale: Makes the 1/4 versus 1 information values exhaustive while preserving strict field-level capability isolation.

nodes.after: Pure exhaustive checker for tau=(R0 R2)(R1 R3), twin involution, change of all four graph triples and both top actions, costs intermediate=5, top=8, CONJ=16, BRIDGE=17, and deletion necessity only. Across 36,864 namespace-tagged bridge cases it verifies the exact pre-final inventory {OLD::old_goal:1,NEW::new_goal:1} and 73,728 single-product deletions; every deletion disables the final craft and leaves fewer than 8 actions to recreate the deleted product. There is no substitution claim or domain and no endpoint except the declared inputs and aggregate output edge.
nodes.rationale: Preserves the coherent twin and cost geometry while deleting the underdefined substitution claim.

nodes.after: Terminal successful-report boundary. acceptance_tests.setup: Enumerate type-preserving bijections in the literal nested raw, intermediate, and top permutation order; construct GRAPH(pi) as four ordered triples and deduplicate graphs in first-occurrence alignment order.
acceptance_tests.expected: Exactly 96 alignments, 48 distinct graphs, four edges per graph, and zero domain or ordering failures.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The exact alignment algebra, literal enumeration order, graph construction, or closed finite domain.
acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: golden_report.json test_receipts[0] with test_id SK01_DOMAIN and observed_counts [96,48,4,0].

acceptance_tests.setup: Deduplicate CAL(pi) in first-occurrence alignment order and partition all 96 alignments by exact CAL tuple.
acceptance_tests.expected: Exactly six calibration classes, each exactly size 16, with zero failures.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: CALSET cardinality or the exact target-local ambiguity partition.

acceptance_tests.setup: For all 12 CALSET-by-goal cases enumerate A(cal), count each TOP pair, and prove the independent two-source-graph product identity by exact integers over the declared RANDOM measure.
acceptance_tests.expected: Each case has four pairs of count four, reduced value 1/4, and zero integer source-factorization failures; receipt observed_counts are exactly [12,4,4,1,4,0].
acceptance_tests.falsifies: RANDOM ambiguity, equiprobability, exact factorization, independence, or Bayes value 1/4.

acceptance_tests.setup: Invoke MOTIF_SCHEMA over every one of the 96 legal common-witness graph,cal,goal tuples and validate cal=first_two(graph).
acceptance_tests.expected: Every legal tuple returns a point mass with reduced value 1 and zero failures; receipt observed_counts are exactly [96,1,1,0].
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The persistent common-alignment point mass, legal MOTIF domain, compatibility rule, or value 1.

acceptance_tests.setup: Apply tau=(R0 R2)(R1 R3) to all 96 alignments and inspect every graph edge and both top goals.
acceptance_tests.expected: All 96 twins round-trip, all four graph triples and both top actions change, and roundtrip, edge-change, and top-action-change failure counts are each zero; receipt observed_counts are exactly [96,0,0,0].
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Twin involution, non-automorphic semantic-content change, or matched-domain authenticity.
acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: golden_report.json test_receipts[4] and the three twin failure fields.

acceptance_tests.setup: Evaluate the exact MOVE+GATHER, craft, intermediate, top, CONJ, and BRIDGE algebra for every declared case.
acceptance_tests.expected: 192 intermediate-role cases cost 5, 192 top-goal cases cost 8, CONJ costs 16, BRIDGE costs 17, and zero failures; receipt observed_counts are exactly [192,5,192,8,16,17,0].
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Any exact symbolic cost or the distinction between conjunction and bridge.
acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: golden_report.json test_receipts[5], cost histograms, conjunctive_cost, and bridge_cost.

acceptance_tests.setup: For each of 36,864 ALIGN-by-ALIGN-by-old_goal-by-new_goal cases verify exact namespace-tagged pre-final inventory, then delete the old product once and the new product once under the spent component budget.
acceptance_tests.expected: Exactly 73,728 deletion checks; every deletion makes the final craft precondition false, emits no BRIDGE::B, and leaves fewer than 8 actions for recreation; dependency failures are zero and receipt observed_counts are exactly [36864,73728,0].

acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: golden_report.json test_receipts[6], bridge_case_count, bridge_deletion_check_count, and bridge_dependency_failures.

acceptance_tests.setup: Enumerate all exact legal domains of sizes 12, 96, 27,648, and 192; verify immutable result shape, complete support order, tie-break, isolation, and DomainError-before-computation for malformed, noncanonical, and incompatible calls.
